recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-24561 unless Pharmacy later changes the MedicationKnowledge ingredient model or the ingredient-strength terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-24561 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request raised in STU3 and applied for R5. It asked to replicate Medication's strengthCodeableConcept capability on MedicationKnowledge so trace/sufficient ingredient strengths could be represented.
initial_application: Jira's application comment points to commit 80c2f73ea490c414129d8406d6d00d4e94af04c0. That commit added MedicationKnowledge ingredient-strength spreadsheet content and the medication-ingredientstrength CodeSystem/ValueSet containing qs and trace, alongside other Pharmacy tracker work.
additional_context: Pharmacy Confluence minutes from 2019-11-25 record FHIR-24561 as voted and approved. Later commit 6422f2f98a0fcf03140c15fe93bfd6c765fc6377 moved MedicationKnowledge ingredient strength under the definitional backbone while preserving strength[x] and its CodeableConcept choice. Commit 129c9fa6f54e03f7a5ebc6de4172227fb2f830dd consolidated the ingredient-strength terminology source under Medication while preserving the canonical URLs and MedicationKnowledge binding.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini actively includes MedicationKnowledge, and source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml defines MedicationKnowledge.definitional.ingredient.strength[x] with Ratio, CodeableConcept, and Quantity choices, binding the CodeableConcept choice to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-ingredientstrength.
